title: Implement error state flag in fd_state
description: Add bool error to crypto2dev_fd_state. Set on update() or finalize() failure. Check at top of write() and read() returning -EIO. Clear in ioctl_reset() on success. -EFAULT from copy_from_user/copy_to_user does not set error (handled before state touch or data still in outbuf).
close_reason: bool error in fd_state; set on update()/finalize() failure and WARN_ON overflow; checked at top of write() and read() OPERATION path returning -EIO; cleared in ioctl_reset() on success; -EFAULT carve-out implicit in code structure; documented in ioctl header.
